findings.summary: Public snapshot mutation does not accept the required stable editor document ID
findings.details: The S03-T03 task contract explicitly requires the public snapshot commit API to accept the stable document ID together with live content/version and the selected revision fence. The implemented public Confect contract instead takes brainKey and pageKey. The stable documentId exists only at the web/editor-sync seam and is translated before the public mutation, so callers can still invoke recordSnapshot without the stable document target the task was intended to make part of the typed contract.
